Maintain controlled tempo on eccentric phase to maximize muscle fiber recruitment.

mobility.description: Requires adequate shoulder, hip and spinal mobility for optimal Flag Hold Plank

techniquePoints: Set up on forearms/hands and toes, forming a straight line from head to heels.

Hold position statically while taking short, controlled breaths.

mobility.description: Requires adequate shoulder, hip and spinal mobility for optimal Floor Dips

techniquePoints: Grip parallel bars firmly, supporting your body weight with arms fully extended and core engaged.

Drive through your palms to return to starting position, locking out elbows with controlled speed.

mobility.description: Requires adequate shoulder, hip and spinal mobility for optimal Flutter Kicks

mobility.description: Requires adequate shoulder, hip and spinal mobility for optimal Fly Push Ups

Lower your chest under control until elbows reach 90 degrees, keeping them angled 45 degrees from your torso.
Press through your palms to lock out, fully engaging your Pectoralis Major, Biceps Brachii, Deltoid Group and protracting scapulae at top.

mobility.description: Requires adequate shoulder, hip and spinal mobility for optimal Frog Squats
